item.title: Implement ledger.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator instruction (authenticated): "Implement `ledger.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Read SPEC.md in the repository root and implement Ledger(balances), transfer(source, destination, amount) -> bool, and snapshot() -> dict, plus MAX_BALANCE = 2**63 - 1, in ledger.py. Preserve the existing public API in ledger.py and keep test_ledger.py passing. Add focused tests in test_ledger.py covering every ValueError, KeyError, and False-return case in the spec, boolean rejection, copy/aliasing isolation for input and snapshots, same-account transfers (including at MAX_BALANCE), amount validation before account lookup, and concurrent transfers (including opposite-direction transfers) with no deadlock and no half-applied snapshots. Tests must not use external services, wall-clock timing, or random inputs. Standard library only. Keep functions under 60 lines, assert at boundaries, and do not hide errors.

pr.body: Approach: one threading.Lock guards every transfer and snapshot. Each transfer validates the amount first, then looks up accounts (KeyError), then checks funds and overflow before writing both sides. A same-account transfer returns True iff funds suffice and never writes. Construction copies the real storage with dict.copy and validates the copy, so dict subclasses cannot hide invalid values. Account names and amounts/balances use exact type checks, which reject bool and str subclasses. Key files: ledger.py, test_ledger.py. Checks: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest test_ledger, 36 tests OK. Lock-removal mutants each fail the pause-based snapshot test. Review: whole-change reads of a422e15 by agt_01M7W54RJDY5SCNWWYS1XBDDQB, agt_01M7W54Z0BZRJJ92DFZ96K0JAR and agt_01M7W555JKS0AFTQ7CVW9K0WB0 (fail, fixed); delta read of a422e15..fd35da6 by agt_01M7W5AEHZ0CJ87VXTTK067FM1 (pass). Open follow-ups: the probe timeout adds 2s; the test assigns private ledger._balances; the opposite-direction and ring tests are smoke tests and do not detect a split lock on their own. Assumptions: an unknown or non-str account name raises KeyError; an unhashable name is treated the same way. Limits: CPython only; the lock is per ledger.
pr.summary: Made Ledger(balances), transfer and snapshot work per SPEC.md. Now: validated construction, atomic transfers under one lock, copy-isolated snapshots, 36 focused tests. Before: ledger.py methods raised NotImplementedError.
